{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the sales data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Display the result
channel_revenue"}
